name: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B-Japanese
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B (config.json max_position_embeddings 131072). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-31. A short (<10 min on 8xL20) Japanese SFT of deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, 7.616B, trained on Japanese translations of argilla reasoning prompts answered by R1-Distill-Llama-70B. The point of the model is language compliance, and that is where it wins biggest: valid-Japanese think 94 vs 48 on the harder Tengentoppa set (RP 1.1) and 84 vs 48 (RP 1.0). It also lifts answer accuracy on the first 50 gsm8k-ja rows, 70 vs 62 (RP 1.1) and 66 vs 60 (RP 1.0). One LOSS is recorded: on the easier gsm8k-ja set at RP 1.0 valid-think drops 92 vs the base's 94. Tiny samples (50 rows each), base printed as rows matched by repetition penalty rather than as a column. Licence Apache-2.0, repo created 2025-01-24. Confidence 0.5.
